th-03iF.title: Sign: two-letter province code on waystones
th-03iF.summary: Waystones and road signs on provincial roads often show a two-letter province abbreviation in Thai script. National roads don't.

th-0BPM.title: Plants: rubber trees with small black cups
th-0BPM.summary: Rubber plantations, mostly in the south. Look for small black cups at the bottom of the trunks.

th-1K3M.title: Sign: white two-part signs, green on highways
th-1K3M.summary: On smaller roads the signs are white, in two parts: an arrow below and info above. Without place names they just show the road number and a Garuda emblem. Highway signs are green, with Latin place names below the local ones.

th-2MMc.title: Plants: areca palms on the peninsula
th-2MMc.summary: Areca palms are mainly on the peninsula, especially around one south-western town.

th-2tIc.title: Bollard: black with three big white reflectors
th-2tIc.summary: A black bollard with three large white reflectors, seen mostly in two north-western provinces.

th-3SeI.title: Plants: dense short coconut groves
th-3SeI.summary: Dense plantations of short or medium coconut palms, mostly west of the capital.

th-3YqS.title: Pole: single insulator on the crossbar
th-3YqS.summary: Poles with just one insulator on the crossbar run from the southern peninsula up to two south-western provinces.

th-3oUo.title: Pole: indented concrete near the capital
th-3oUo.summary: Regular poles with a Chile-style indent around the capital. Larger, thicker indented poles appear on highways everywhere.

th-4W5G.title: Google car: Gen 3 with no visible car
th-4W5G.summary: Most Gen 3 coverage shows no car. The Laos capital and some Gen 3 in Cambodia also have no car. Rare bike trekkers and a white car with a brake light appear too.

th-4yTx.title: Plants: palmyra palms near the south-east coast
th-4yTx.summary: Large numbers of palmyra palms near the eastern coast of the peninsula, just south of the capital and in the far south. Single or small groups appear everywhere.

th-5jsO.title: Farming: wet-season rice in the east
th-5jsO.summary: During the wet season, most rice is grown in the eastern plains.

th-6EeW.title: Landscape: third tallest mountain in view
th-6EeW.summary: The country's third tallest mountain and other distinctly shaped mountains can be seen clearly from one northern district.

th-6ONJ.title: Landscape: big bare-rock mountains, east-west
th-6ONJ.summary: The northern half of one central province has large, exposed-rock mountains in an east-west line.

th-7EBY.title: Fields: north-east to south-west grid, industry
th-7EBY.summary: A north-east to south-west grid with modern and industrial buildings among rubber, cassava and pineapple fields, in the west of one eastern province.

th-7hzC.title: Plants: durian plantations, cone-shaped young
th-7hzC.summary: Most common in the south-east but found on the peninsula and elsewhere. Young trees look cone-shaped. Grown ones have dark bark, branches nearly reaching the ground and pointed oblong leaves.

th-85br.title: Landscape: wind turbines in a few places
th-85br.summary: Wind turbines are mostly on the west side of two north-eastern provinces and on the eastern coast of two southern provinces.

th-9LG9.title: Fields: large almost perfect north-south grid
th-9LG9.summary: A large, almost perfectly north-south grid in central and eastern parts of one central province.

th-CKg2.title: Landscape: jagged limestone peaks, far bank
th-CKg2.summary: In the north-east along the Mekong you sometimes see jagged limestone peaks to the north-east. They stand on the Lao side and are visible from far away.

differs.how: The peaks themselves are in Laos

th-Cl8a.title: Google car: bars poking out of the blur
th-Cl8a.summary: A rare Google car found only on one small island, recognisable by bars sticking out of the blur.

th-F0Y9.title: Landscape: touristy islands, narrow roads
th-F0Y9.summary: Two touristy islands with narrow, crowded roads and a tropical feel.

th-GQ8g.title: Road: brown paved road among sugarcane and corn
th-GQ8g.summary: Brown paved roads among sugarcane, cassava and corn fields, found in the south-east of one north-eastern province.

th-GpFr.title: Farming: corn in the north and centre
th-GpFr.summary: Corn is most commonly seen in the north and central regions.

th-HYNG.title: Plants: cassava, bush with fingered leaves
th-HYNG.summary: Cassava is a bush with leaves split like fingers. Found in most of the country, but much more common in the central and north-eastern plains.

th-IFUq.title: Google car: smudge on front left of camera
th-IFUq.summary: A smudge on the front left of the camera appears on a densely forested national park road and in nearby provinces. Other smudges may rarely exist elsewhere.

th-JvSJ.title: Landscape: two flat, dry regions
th-JvSJ.summary: Two relatively flat and dry regions: one north of the capital, one further east. The eastern one can feel drier.

th-KSpq.title: Landscape: big north-south mountains both sides
th-KSpq.summary: Large north-south mountains on either side of a valley in the north-centre.

th-LKJb.title: Sign: bulky white signpost, black bottom
th-LKJb.summary: Square, bulky, usually white signposts, often with the bottom painted black. Unique in Southeast Asia.

th-Lj1E.title: Boxes: black boxes with 3-letter province code
th-Lj1E.summary: Black boxes often show a three-letter province code, either starting with it followed by 4 numbers, or starting with TCC-L2 followed by the code. Other boxes may show the subdistrict.

th-M10h.title: Landscape: large bare-rock mountains, north-south
th-M10h.summary: Western Krabi and parts of eastern Phang-nga have large exposed-rock mountains running north-south.

th-MZov.title: Roads: gravel roads
th-MZov.summary: Gravel roads appear everywhere but are most common in the darkly highlighted areas on the map.

th-MmZp.title: Plants: tall coconut plantations, south-west
th-MmZp.summary: Slightly less dense plantations of tall coconut palms, most common in one south-western province. The entire peninsula has many coconut palms, this is about plantations only.

th-NLmR.title: Plants: Tenasserim pines in the north
th-NLmR.summary: Pine trees of this kind are almost exclusively in the north and north-west.

th-OGfz.title: Landscape: tall mountains in the north-west
th-OGfz.summary: Tall mountains are most often seen in the north-west, and also parts of the southern peninsula.

th-QXyi.title: Farming: sugar cane in the centre and east
th-QXyi.summary: Sugar cane is mostly grown in the centre and east.

th-QZgS.title: Plants: teak, big leaves and yellow flowers
th-QZgS.summary: Teak grows in high densities in the north. It has large leaves and yellow flowers, and is often planted as decoration along highways.

th-Rqm9.title: Taxis: pink, or yellow on green
th-Rqm9.summary: The capital has pink taxis and yellow-on-green ones. Yellow-on-green may rarely appear elsewhere, but pink is practically exclusive.

th-SrCQ.title: Flags: many along the street, yellow royal
th-SrCQ.summary: Streets are often lined with flags: the national flag and yellow royal flags.

th-ThIf.title: Vehicles: red pickup-truck buses
th-ThIf.summary: Red trucks called songthaews act as transport, most common in one northern city.

th-USoN.title: Farming: big fruit plantations
th-USoN.summary: The biggest fruit plantations are in a northern valley and in the far eastern provinces.

th-UnwR.title: Religion: Islamic dress and Jawi script
th-UnwR.summary: Most Muslims live in the very south. There you often see Islamic dress, mosques and Jawi script, based on Arabic, on signs.

th-V3cL.title: Road: concrete with big square slabs
th-V3cL.summary: Concrete roads with a large square pattern are common. The Philippines has them too, Indonesia less often.

th-V83y.title: Street sign: helmet-shaped
th-V83y.summary: Helmet-shaped street signs are found only in one seaside city.

th-VtmL.title: Landscape: touristy rich island with resorts
th-VtmL.summary: A wealthy tourist island with modern buildings, resorts and heavy traffic among hills.

th-ZxIl.title: Farming: rice within highlighted area
th-ZxIl.summary: Most rice is grown within the highlighted area on the map.

th-aRcg.title: Driving side: left
th-aRcg.summary: Traffic drives on the left. Cambodia, Vietnam and Laos drive on the right.

th-aVcK.title: Route numbers: first digit shows region
th-aVcK.summary: National roads starting with 1 are in the north, 2 the north-east, 3 the centre and 4 the south. Big one- and two-digit highways cross regions, and provincial roads don't follow this.

th-ahtf.title: Sign: stop sign in local script, 3 characters
th-ahtf.summary: Stop signs use Thai script, not Latin. Laos uses a similar script but has only 2 characters.

differs.how: Lao stop signs have 2 characters, not 3

th-b81q.title: Road: four-lane divided with huge gap
th-b81q.summary: A divided four-lane highway with a very wide gap in the middle. You often can't see the other side, but a yellow inner line shows the road is divided.

th-bIyP.title: Soil: deep red fields, cassava and rubber
th-bIyP.summary: Deep red fields with cassava and rubber trees in one western province.

th-bTGN.title: Bollard: square, pointed top, striped
th-bTGN.summary: Square concrete bollard with a pointed top and black-and-white stripes. Cambodia, Laos and Indonesia have it too.

th-cZKi.title: Landscape: long low hills among crop fields
th-cZKi.summary: One north-eastern province has many long, low hills among fields of rice, sugarcane, cassava and rubber trees.

th-eRwQ.title: Landscape: tallest steep bare-rock mountains
th-eRwQ.summary: Some of the tallest, steepest exposed-rock mountains in the south, running east-west, in a national park.

th-eYu7.title: Landscape: big bare-rock massifs
th-eYu7.summary: Large, distinct exposed-rock mountain massifs in a western coastal province, visible from the centre of the province.

th-eo9N.title: Plants: eucalyptus plantations in the east
th-eo9N.summary: Dense eucalyptus plantations are most common around one eastern border province. Eucalyptus lining roads can appear elsewhere in small amounts.

th-fymE.title: Landscape: distinctly shaped mountains, centre
th-fymE.summary: Distinctly shaped mountains in the south-west of one central province.

th-g8on.title: Landscape: low smooth forested mountains
th-g8on.summary: Low, smooth, forested mountains in the centre-north of the country.

th-gQgT.title: Plants: palm oil plantations, south
th-gQgT.summary: Over 90% of palm oil is produced in the south, so oil palm plantations show up most there.

th-govn.title: Fields: north-north-west grid, ridges around
th-govn.summary: A large, slightly north-north-west grid of rice, corn, sugarcane and cassava fields, with ridges often visible to the north, south and west.

th-hzDI.title: Houses: grey corrugated metal roofs
th-hzDI.summary: Grey corrugated metal roofs are most common in the north and south, but appear everywhere occasionally.

th-jv6p.title: Road: brown paved road among bananas and durians
th-jv6p.summary: Brown paved roads among bananas, durians, rubber and corn, in the south of one north-eastern province. Another province may look similar.

th-nnts.title: Street sign: small green strip under blue
th-nnts.summary: Street signs with a smaller green section beneath a blue section, found in the capital and a neighbouring province.

th-oN48.title: Poles: long thin lamp arms over the road
th-oN48.summary: Very long, thin lamp posts that hang out over the side of the road.

th-p3S3.title: Road lines: yellow middle lines
th-p3S3.summary: Yellow middle lines, solid or dashed. Malaysia only has white middle lines.

differs.how: Malaysia only has white middle lines

th-pELn.title: Marker: road markers with white or black Garuda
th-pELn.summary: Road markers carry a white or black Garuda bird emblem. White is on national roads, black on provincial roads.

th-pVKM.title: Pole: red-black or black-white striped base
th-pVKM.summary: Street light poles have red-and-black or black-and-white stripes at the bottom.

th-peOM.title: Pole: two insulators on the crossbar
th-peOM.summary: Poles with two insulators on the crossbar are found in the rest of the country.

th-qBp9.title: Google car: rare car with a visible mirror
th-qBp9.summary: A rare Google car with a visible mirror, found only in the far south. Most of it was overwritten by Gen 4, so it's rarely seen.

th-r6yh.title: Farming: dry-season rice in the central plains
th-r6yh.summary: Dry-season rice is most common in the central plains. The dry season often shows as haze in the sky from wildfires.

th-rOan.title: Landscape: steep rocky mountains, west and south
th-rOan.summary: Steep mountains with a lot of bare rock, most common in the west and on the peninsula.

th-rjs3.title: Pole: insulators with 7+ ridges
th-rjs3.summary: Insulators with seven or more ridges are in the southern half of the peninsula and on highways in two northern provinces. Five or six ridges are standard everywhere else.

th-rzJ6.title: Plate: large white, yellow for commercial
th-rzJ6.summary: Big white plates on private vehicles, yellow on commercial ones. Yellow commercial plates are only found here in Southeast Asia, but Laos uses yellow on normal cars.

differs.how: Laos uses short yellow plates on ordinary cars

th-sHFO.title: Phone numbers: 9-digit landline, 02 for capital
th-sHFO.summary: Landlines have 9 digits. The capital's area code is 02 and others have three digits. Area codes are grouped, so the first digit helps. Mobiles start with 08 or 09 and have 10 digits, and 06 numbers are not regional.

th-tQaR.title: Landscape: tourist road with resorts, rocky hills
th-tQaR.summary: Near a famous national park, rural roads are lined with ads, restaurants and resorts. Large rocky hills show closer to two neighbouring provinces.

th-tWkN.title: Landscape: very long flat mountain ridges
th-tWkN.summary: Very long, flat mountain ridges visible from almost anywhere in one north-eastern province.

th-tgzM.title: Landscape: rolling hills of corn and sugar cane
th-tgzM.summary: Rolling hills of corn or sugar cane in the west of one province, where paved roads often look very brown.

th-tqgy.title: Soil: red, mostly north-east
th-tqgy.summary: Red soil is most common in the north-east, but appears across the whole country.

th-uY5m.title: Street sign: red with golden border
th-uY5m.summary: Red street signs with golden decorated borders are in one northern city. Blue ones with the same border also exist there.

th-vdHm.title: Landscape: flat valley ringed by mountains
th-vdHm.summary: A fairly flat valley surrounded by mountains on every side, commonly growing rice and fruit.

th-w9ag.title: Pole: square with holes up the side
th-w9ag.summary: Square concrete poles with small vertical holes. Sri Lanka, Cambodia and Laos have similar ones, so check other clues.

th-wkCZ.title: Landscape: jagged north-south ridge to the east
th-wkCZ.summary: A large, slightly jagged north-south ridge runs through the middle of one northern province, visible to the east from afar.

th-wtTr.title: Plants: garden croton, yellow-red leaves
th-wtTr.summary: A decorative plant with yellow, orange and red leaves, most common around one south-western town and other coastal provinces.

th-xPZV.title: Sign: distinctive green village sign
th-xPZV.summary: A distinctive green sign found across the country, often in small villages. It exists in no other country.

th-zUbl.title: Farming: pineapple plantations near the capital
th-zUbl.summary: Pineapple plantations are most common south-east and south-west of the capital.

th-zad0.title: Language: compact script with tiny circles
th-zad0.summary: Compact script with small circles in many letters. Cambodian script has longer lines and more marks underneath. Lao looks similar, so check the driving side.

differs.how: Cambodian script has longer lines, more marks below
Laos looks similar but drives on the right
